title: Companion actual node, Git and task progress pushes
description: D06 AC4 proof using real private source writers. Root owns all execution authorization, private authenticated node/gateway/proxy, app signing/profile/bootstrap and serial device window. Prepare the exclusive source fixture before root starts its services, integrate the separate read-only dev-frame patch, then retain the dry input-hashed plan. The command never starts services, launches or restarts an app, boots/erases a simulator, dispatches a worker/provider, or records video. It opens genuine routes and writes only real private source files. The marked slotted diff query keeps the current runId ownership pin; the gateway strips that metadata before legacy Git dispatch. No nodes.list mounted-consumer, node lifecycle, cold-store or idle claim. Params are absent.

proofTargets.claim: A real private node HEAD observation changes the actual branch on the still-open Companion slot panel without Refresh.
The task-local mark writer changes CHECKLIST.md and SIGNAL.json; the still-open canonical progress panel shows the completed step and its actual timing.
A real temporary worktree write changes the still-open canonical slotted Git diff and visible content without Refresh.
The existing passive method-counting proxy confirms no Refresh or native command RPC while actual app fleet/progress/Git reads traverse it.
The marked live diff retains the exact slot and current run ownership pin and loads current worktree bytes through the node.

attached.intent: Attach to the existing owned iOS app and device session.

prove.intent: Prove real source pushes in mounted panels with the checked private fixture.

node-slot.intent: Verify the node HEAD change in the open slot panel without Refresh.

task-mark.intent: Verify the real mark updates the open checklist and step timing.

git.intent: Verify the worktree write updates the open slotted diff without Refresh.

no-refresh.intent: Verify real panel reads and no Refresh or native command through the passive proxy.

slot-diff-routing.intent: Inspect the actual mounted canonical request and current worktree diff.
